camel_example:
aliyun rds DescribeRCInstances --region cn-hangzhou --HostIp '172.16.XX.XX' --Status Running --Description Instance_Description --PageSize 10 --InstanceId 'rc-i2p26bde8bckf141****
' --PublicIp '121.89.XX.XX' --ClusterId 'c463aaa89e2b84cacacfbf23c4867****' --DescriptionForFuzzy Instance --InstanceName 'k8s-node' --VpcId 'vpc-uf6f7l4fg90****' --PageNumber 1 --ImageId 'image-dsvjzw2ii8n4******' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tag '{"testRC":"test01"}' --InstanceIds '["rc-i2p26bde8bckf141****","rc-l1753m982otq2s2m****"]'
description_en: Queries a list of RDS Custom instances. If no instance ID is specified, this operation returns a list of all RDS Custom instances in the specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribeRCInstances接口查询指定RDS Custom实例列表信息。如果未指定实例ID（InstanceId），则将返回目标地域内所有RDS Custom实例列表信息
kebab_example:
aliyun rds describe-rc-instances --vpc-id 'vpc-uf6f7l4fg90****' --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id 'rc-i2p26bde8bckf141****
' --tag '{"testRC":"test01"}' --public-ip 121.89.XX.XX --host-ip 172.16.XX.XX --instance-ids '["rc-i2p26bde8bckf141****","rc-l1753m982otq2s2m****"]' --status Running --instance-name k8s-node --image-id 'image-dsvjzw2ii8n4******' --description Instance_Description --description-for-fuzzy Instance --cluster-id 'c463aaa89e2b84cacacfbf23c4867****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRCInstances

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paging query.

Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100；默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the instance status list.

Starting value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态列表的页码。

起始值：1；默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. This parameter is used to query a single instance.

If no instance ID is specified (neither InstanceId nor InstanceIds is specified), the details of all RDS Custom instances in the specified region are returned
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。此参数用于查询单个实例。

如果未指定实例ID（InstanceId与InstanceIds均为传入参数值），则将返回目标地域内所有RDS Custom实例的详细信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The tags used to filter instances. Input format: `{"TagKey":"TagValue"}`
parameters.help_zh: 按指定标签查询。输入格式为：`{"TagKey（标签建）":"TagValue（标签值）"}`
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The public IP address used to filter instances
parameters.name: public_ip

parameters.help_en: The host IP address used to filter instances
parameters.name: host_ip

parameters.help_en:
The instance IDs.

This parameter is used to query multiple instances at a time. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 instance IDs. Input format: `["InstanceId1","InstanceId2"]`.

If both InstanceIds and InstanceId are specified, the value of InstanceIds prevails
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

此参数用于同时查询多个实例。实例ID间使用英文逗号（,）分割，且最多支持100个ID。输入格式为：`["实例ID1","实例ID2"]`。

当InstanceIds和instanceId同时传入参数时，以InstanceIds的值为准
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

Pending: The instance is being created.
Running: The instance is running.
Starting: The instance is starting.
Stopping: The instance is being stopped.
Stopped: The instance is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。取值范围：

Pending：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Starting：启动中。
Stopping：暂停中。
Stopped：已暂停
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The image ID used to filter instances
parameters.help_zh: 按实例使用的镜像 ID 筛选
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The description used to filter instances
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to perform a fuzzy match on the instance description
parameters.help_zh: 按实例描述进行模糊查询
parameters.name: description_for_fuzzy

parameters.help_en: The RDS Custom container cluster ID used to filter instances
parameters.help_zh: 按 RDS Custom 容器集群 ID 筛选
parameters.name: cluster_id

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

AutoRenew.description_en: Specifies whether auto-renewal is enabled for the instance

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the RDS Custom container cluster to which the instance belongs
ClusterId.description_zh: 实例所属 RDS Custom 容器集群的 ID

CreateMode.description_en:
Specifies whether the instance is allowed to join an ACK cluster. If the parameter settings are 1, the created instance can be added to an ACK cluster by calling the AttachRCInstances API operation to efficiently manage containerized applications. Valid values:

1: yes
0 (default): no
CreateMode.description_zh:
是否允许加入ACK集群。该参数配置为1时，创建的实例可以通过API接口AttachRCInstances添加到ACK集群中，从而实现对容器应用的高效管理。

1：是
0（默认）：否

ExpiredTime.description_en:
The time when the instance expires. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and uses the UTC+0 time zone in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format.

The expiration time displayed in the console is 8 hours ahead of this time
ExpiredTime.description_zh:
实例到期时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the task was created in GMT

HostIp.description_en: The IP address of the host

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
InstanceChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值如下：
PrePaid：包年包月
PostPaid：按量付费

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type.

For more information, see [RDS Custom instance types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2844823.html）
InstanceType.description_zh:
实例规格。

更多信息请参见[RDS Custom实例规格列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2844823.html）

InstanceTypeFamily.description_en:
The instance family.

For more information, see [RDS Custom instance types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2844823.html）
InstanceTypeFamily.description_zh:
实例规格族。


更多信息请参见[RDS Custom实例规格列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2844823.html）

NodeType.description_en: The node type. A value of rds_vnode indicates that the node is a container node
NodeType.description_zh: 节点类型。返回rds_vnode时，表示该节点是容器节点

OSName.description_en: The name of the operating system

OSType.description_en:
The type of the operating system. The operating system can be Windows Server or Linux. Valid values:

windows
linux
OSType.description_zh:
实例的操作系统类型，分为 Windows Server 和 Linux 两种。可能值：

windows。
linux
OSType.title_en:
实例的操作系统类型，分为 Windows Server 和 Linux 两种。可能值：

windows。
linux。
OSType.title_zh:
实例的操作系统类型，分为 Windows Server 和 Linux 两种。可能值：

windows。
linux。

PublicIp.description_en: The public IP address of the instance

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The bidding strategy for the pay-as-you-go instance. Valid values:

NoSpot: The instance is a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotAsPriceGo: The system automatically places bids based on the current market price
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
按量付费实例的竞价策略。返回值如下：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格

StartTime.description_en: The last start time of the instance. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format
StartTime.description_zh: 实例最近一次的启动时间。以 ISO 8601 为标准，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
StartTime.title_en: 实例最近一次的启动时间。以 ISO 8601 为标准，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。
StartTime.title_zh: 实例最近一次的启动时间。以 ISO 8601 为标准，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

Pending: The instance is being created.
Running: The instance is running.
Starting: The instance is starting.
Stopping: The instance is being stopped.
Stopped: The instance is stopped.

The instance status returned by this operation may be delayed. If the status differs from the value returned by the DescribeRCInstanceAttribute operation, the value returned by the DescribeRCInstanceAttribute operation prevails
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。返回值如下：

Pending：创建中
Running：运行中
Starting：启动中
Stopping：暂停中
Stopped：已暂停

此接口返回的实例状态可能存在延迟，如果与DescribeRCInstanceAttribute接口返回值存在差异，请以DescribeRCInstanceAttribute接口为准

StoppedMode.description_en: The stop mode of the instance. KeepCharging indicates the standard mode. StopCharging indicates the economical mode. Not-applicable indicates that the instance does not support the economical mode
StoppedMode.description_zh: 实例的停机模式。KeepCharging 表示普通停机，StopCharging 表示节省停机，Not-applicable 表示实例不支持停机不收费

TagResources.description_en: The queried instance and tag details
TagResources.description_zh: 查询到的实例和标签详情

items.description_en: The queried instance and tag details
items.description_zh: 查询到的实例和标签详情

ResourceType.description_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

`ALIYUN::RDS::INSTANCE`: ApsaraDB RDS instance
`ALIYUN::RDS::CUSTOM`: RDS Custom instance
ResourceType.description_zh:
资源类型。

`ALIYUN::RDS::INSTANCE`：云数据库RDS实例
`ALIYUN::RDS::CUSTOM`：RDS Custom实例
